parameters.query:
WITH stale_jobs AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        job_type,
        campaign_id,
        attempts,
        max_attempts,
        locked_at

    FROM automation_jobs

    WHERE status = 'processing'

      AND locked_at <
          NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'

    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
),

updated_jobs AS (
    UPDATE automation_jobs j

    SET
        status =
            CASE
                WHEN stale.attempts <
                     stale.max_attempts
                    THEN 'queued'

                ELSE 'failed'
            END,

        available_at =
            CASE
                WHEN stale.attempts <
                     stale.max_attempts

                    THEN NOW()
                       + (
                           INTERVAL '5 minutes'
                           * GREATEST(
                               stale.attempts,
                               1
                           )
                         )

                ELSE j.available_at
            END,

        locked_at = NULL,

        completed_at =
            CASE
                WHEN stale.attempts >=
                     stale.max_attempts
                    THEN NOW()

                ELSE NULL
            END,

        last_error =
            CASE
                WHEN stale.attempts <
                     stale.max_attempts

                    THEN
                      'Automatically requeued after exceeding the processing timeout.'

                ELSE
                      'Maximum attempts reached after repeated processing timeouts.'
            END

    FROM stale_jobs stale

    WHERE j.id = stale.id

    RETURNING
        j.id,
        j.job_type,
        j.campaign_id,
        j.status,
        j.attempts,
        j.max_attempts,
        j.available_at,
        j.last_error
),

failed_campaigns AS (
    UPDATE campaigns c

    SET status = 'automation_error'

    FROM updated_jobs j

    WHERE c.id = j.campaign_id

      AND j.status = 'failed'

      AND c.status NOT IN (
          'completed',
          'rejected',
          'archived'
      )

    RETURNING c.id
),

write_logs AS (
    INSERT INTO automation_logs (
        workflow_name,
        campaign_id,
        level,
        event_type,
        message,
        details
    )

    SELECT
        '12 - Automation Job Recovery',

        job.campaign_id,

        CASE
            WHEN job.status = 'failed'
                THEN 'error'
            ELSE 'warning'
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN job.status = 'failed'
                THEN 'automation_job_failed'
            ELSE 'automation_job_requeued'
        END,

        job.last_error,

        jsonb_build_object(
            'job_id',
                job.id,

            'job_type',
                job.job_type,

            'attempts',
                job.attempts,

            'max_attempts',
                job.max_attempts,

            'next_available_at',
                job.available_at
        )

    FROM updated_jobs job

    RETURNING id
)

SELECT
    id::TEXT AS job_id,
    job_type,
    campaign_id::TEXT AS campaign_id,
    status,
    attempts,
    max_attempts,
    available_at,
    last_error

FROM updated_jobs;

versionMetadata.name: Automation Job Recovery v1
versionMetadata.description: Added scheduled recovery for stale automation jobs, automatic retries with backoff, failure handling after maximum attempts, campaign error status updates, and recovery logging.
